To work to ensure the consistency, quality and efficiency of food and beverage service and amenities for the hotel’s guest rooms & suites. To follow the wishes and preferences of our guests.

d: 🌟 We're Hiring: Senior Graphic Designer / Visual Communication Designer / Graphic Design Lead

We are a creative and business-oriented organization focused on developing impactful visual content and strengthening brand communication across digital and traditional platforms. Through thoughtful design, creative storytelling, and consistent visual standards, we aim to deliver engaging experiences that connect with audiences and support business growth.

We are seeking an experienced graphic design professional to support creative projects, visual communication, and brand development initiatives. This role combines creative execution with design planning, ensuring that visual materials communicate ideas effectively while maintaining consistency across different platforms.

Working remotely with flexible part-time hours, you will collaborate with marketing, communications, and business teams to develop high-quality design solutions that align with brand objectives and project requirements.
Develop creative concepts and visual materials for digital, print, and marketing campaigns.
Create graphics, layouts, presentations, and branded communication materials.
Maintain visual consistency across brand assets and communication channels.
Translate creative briefs and business requirements into effective design solutions.
Collaborate with marketing and communications teams on campaign development.
Review design work and provide creative direction to support quality standards.
Manage design projects, priorities, and deadlines across multiple assignments.
Evaluate visual trends and recommend fresh creative approaches.
Optimize design assets for websites, social media, presentations, and other platforms.
Support brand development initiatives and contribute to continuous creative improvement.
Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Digital Media, or a related field preferred.
At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in graphic design or visual communication preferred.
Strong understanding of design principles, typography, color theory, and visual composition.
Knowledge of branding, layout development, and digital content design.
Proficiency in professional graphic design and creative software.
Familiarity with digital marketing materials, social media formats, and print production.
Ability to interpret creative briefs and develop concepts that meet business objectives.
Strong attention to detail, creativity, and visual problem-solving skills.
Good communication and collaboration abilities when working with different teams.
Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a remote working environment.
Flexible part-time working hours with a fully remote arrangement.
Competitive compensation aligned with experience and responsibilities.
Opportunities to contribute to diverse creative and brand development projects.
Exposure to international campaigns and cross-functional creative initiatives.
Professional development in visual communication, digital design, and creative strategy.
A collaborative environment that values creativity, originality, and high-quality work.
